profile.org_note: Founder-owned private builder with no regions: a small corporate team in Huntsville (founder/chairman Adam Davidson, CEO Brandon Jones) over market divisions, each run by a division president who, per a third-party org chart, reports straight to the CEO. Land is run in the divisions by VPs of land acquisition (named for Raleigh, Atlanta, Houston and Dallas); no company-wide head of land is public, and the founder and CEO are personally involved in land and builder deals. The CFO seat is unconfirmed (last named 2021); the Corporate Controller is the senior finance name with a 2026 record. The company publishes no leadership page. Legal name is from the Huntsville Chamber listing; the website footer reads 'Davidson Homes, Inc.', and a 2020 article names Davidson Holding Co. as parent.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @davidsonhomes.com (one published example only: the media contact)
profile.summary: Privately held Huntsville, AL builder, No. 43 on the 2026 Builder 100 (up from 46 and 60), with about 105 active communities in six states (AL, TN, GA, NC, TX, AZ). It grows three ways: organically in existing divisions, by starting new markets with a land hire first (Dallas 2024, Charlotte 2025, Auburn 2026), and by buying builders for their lots (Kindred's San Antonio assets 2023, New Leaf Homes 2024, Evermore Homes 2025 with about 2,000 lots). Management describes a lot-light approach, including buying finished lots from other builders; it launched a mortgage joint venture with loanDepot in November 2026.
